scope: assumption-level applicability audit for controlled reduced ChaCha under the canonical fixed-single-key sequential-counter source model; no attack benchmark unless applicability passes
literature_basis: Barbero, Bellini, Makarim, Rotational analysis of ChaCha permutation, arXiv:2008.13406
Liu et al., Rotational Differential-Linear Cryptanalysis Revisited, Journal of Cryptology 2023

canonical_source_model.key: one unknown fixed key for all blocks
canonical_source_model.observable: ChaCha block output P_R(S)+S only; no arbitrary raw permutation oracle

direct_rotational_pair_requirement: For the permutation construction, paired states must satisfy S' = Rot_r(S) word-wise before applying the same permutation.
rx_requirement: For RX generalization, paired chosen data must have a specified/usable rotational-XOR relation; source may not substitute an unknown key-dependent RX difference post hoc.
checks: CONST_INVARIANT: Rot_r(c_i)=c_i for all four fixed constants
SAME_KEY_GENERIC: the direct relation must hold for an arbitrary unknown fixed key without replacing it by Rot_r(K)
SOURCE_COUNTER_PAIR: at least one c,c' in 1..1875 with c'=Rot_r(c) for the direct state relation
NONCE_COMPATIBLE: fixed zero nonce is rotation-compatible
OBSERVABLE_COMPATIBLE: published permutation relation must be testable from P_R(S)+S without knowing the secret state/key or querying P_R directly
RX_KEY_DIFFERENCE_KNOWN: any required RX difference on key words must be public/controlled rather than Rot_r(K) xor K for unknown K
stage1_gate: At least one nonzero r must satisfy every essential direct-rotational check, OR the literature must provide a same-key source-observable RX construction whose required key/state relation is fully known/controlled in this model.
kill_rule: If fixed constants destroy every nonzero direct rotational input pair and the only workaround requires rotated/related keys, chosen rotational states, unknown key-dependent RX differences, or a raw permutation oracle unavailable in the source model, close as NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_FDS_SINGLE_KEY_SOURCE_MODEL. Do not fabricate a statistical benchmark.
stage1_only_if_pass: Freeze a separate same-key source-orbit rotational statistic and TOTAL implication before any measurement. A permutation distinguisher alone is never an alpha claim.
forbidden: No related-key oracle, no rotated secret key construction, no chosen nonce/constant modification, no counters outside 1..1875, no raw permutation oracle assumption, no full-round claim.
